title: Carousel Ring
description: A merry-go-round of cards in real 3D: eight panels riding a ring that never stops turning.
usage: Eight panels on a preserve-3d ring, one spin keyframe, perspective on the stage — the whole illusion is geometry. Hover pauses the ride so a panel can actually be read, which separates a carousel from a rumor. Put the parts, the plans, or the team on the horses.
a11y: The ring is a rotating picture of a list: name the list in the figure’s label and keep a static version reachable on the page. Rotation stops on hover and entirely under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving the front panel facing the reader.
